request: Produce the current low-stock section. Every listed product and quantity must match the Inventory and Products tables exactly, with no invented products.
source_of_truth: MarketLoop grounded Environment backed by the real SQLite database / MCP system of record.

evaluation.source_of_truth: MarketLoop grounded Environment backed by the real SQLite database / MCP system of record.

output:
```sql
SELECT p.product_name, i.quantity
FROM Inventory i
JOIN Products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.quantity < 10;
```

This query will produce the current low-stock section by joining the Inventory and Products tables based on the product_id. It then selects the product_name and quantity from the joined tables where the quantity is less than 10.
